title: The specified graph comparison for finite etale morphisms
statement: Let $A$ be any commutative ring and $f:U\to X$ a finite etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] [def-weil-etale-morphism]. For every compactification $c$ the specified natural transformation $Da:Df_{\Sigma!}\to Rr_*Dj_!$ [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison] is an isomorphism. No Noetherianity, boundedness, or finiteness of $A$ is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03S3 (definition-extension-zero), 03S5 (proposition-describe-jshriek), 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale); more-etale.tex Tags 0F50, 0F51 and 0F7B-0F7F; graph-adjunction normalization on unbounded complexes supplied by the agent

proof.text: Since f is proper, its compactification open immersion j has closed range. The canonical j!→j_* is an isomorphism. The map compactificationSheafToDirectImage is therefore an isomorphism. By [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-sheaf-normalization], composing the graph sheaf map with it gives the canonical finite-etale sum-to-product comparison, invertible by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-star-finite-modules]. Cancellation makes the graph sheaf map an isomorphism.

proof.text: Write F=j!, G=r_*. The functor F is isomorphic to j_* and hence is right adjoint to exact restriction; the induced hom-complex adjunction shows that F preserves K-injective complexes. The graph sheaf isomorphism identifies FG with the exact sum functor, so FG is exact. Thus the right-derived units of F and FG are invertible. The right-derived composition comparison is invertible because F preserves K-injectives. Its defining factorization identifies its composite unit with the FG unit followed by the composition isomorphism. Consequently this composite unit is invertible.

source.place: Tags 03S3 (definition-extension-zero), 03S5 (proposition-describe-jshriek), 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale); more-etale.tex Tags 0F50, 0F51 and 0F7B-0F7F; graph-adjunction normalization on unbounded complexes supplied by the agent

proof.text: At any homotopy complex K the composite unit is Qh of the inverse homotopy compositor, followed by the G unit at F(K), followed by RG of the F unit. The first and third factors are isomorphisms; cancellation proves the G unit at F(K) is an isomorphism. The homotopy map of the graph sheaf isomorphism is an isomorphism, with inverse the homotopy map of its inverse, since this construction preserves identities and composition. Thus every factor of the proved Qh-component formula of [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison] is invertible.

proof.text: Assemble componentwise invertibility after precomposing with Qh. The fully faithful whiskering functor for the localization Qh reflects isomorphisms, proving invertibility of the specified natural transformation. This argument includes empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring.

      (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c))
